_about: Sandown Park for tools/course/real/layout.py. Ring 0 = OSM's outer edge of the turf; ring 1 = the big infield (the golf course); ring 2 = the long hole between the sprint course and the home straight (the go-karts and the old jumps ground); rings 3 and 4 small holes inside the home bend (point numbers on reference/sandown/plan-draft.png, lower panel). Right-handed. The flat course runs on the outside of the turf all the way round, its inside rail 26 m in from OSM's outer edge (the jumps courses inside it). The sprint course is the strip between rings 1 and 2, running diagonally across the middle from the chute in the far (north-east) bend to its own winning post at the west end (At The Races: 'steady rise throughout'); it is its own route ('straight') with its own post. The owner's Google Maps views (19 Nov) confirm the layout.

tv.note: Sandown (owner, 19 Nov 13:34, his Racing TV video of a 2m50y race): head-on down the home straight from the outside of the west bend as they come past the stands the first time; the infield car alongside, the stand side behind them; head-on again into the west bend; high across the bend from inside it; the tracking car up the west side; the infield car all along the back straight, the golf course in front of it, the houses beyond; head-on at the end of the back straight from behind the chase fences; head-on round the far bend; high across the end of the bend; the tracking car down the east side; the infield car up the run-in, the stand side behind; then the finish square on from the infield, the stands behind the line. The sprint course: the tracking car, its head-on, its own finish camera (cameraSwap). Sprint course (owner, 13:52, his Racing TV video of a 5f10y race): one camera alongside the whole way, on the near (festival) side looking across the field to the far rail, the bushes and the golf course beyond, the near rail's crowd in the foreground at the end; then the finish square on from the near side, the boards on the far rail at the line.

view.lede: Sandown Park in 3D, right-handed, on its real outline (OpenStreetMap) and real ground (AWS Terrain Tiles): the stiff climb of about 13 m up the last half-mile to the stands, and the sprint course running uphill across the middle to its own winning post. The two main grandstands modelled from your photos: the main stand with its deep ribbed roof, the fins on top and the row of white peaked tents along its back, and the Eclipse stand beside it. A full festival between the run-in and the sprint course, the bushes along the sprint's far side, and the TV cut from your two Racing TV videos.
notes: OpenStreetMap's outline of the turf (the west bend's sharp corner rounded by hand), the starts where At The Races' diagram puts them, and the ground under every route for the race engine: the round course climbs about 13 m in the last half-mile, the sprint course about 9 m.
The 5f starts in the chute in the far bend and runs diagonally across the middle to its own post at the west end, with its own finishing line, finish camera, head-on and replay.
The main stand and the Eclipse stand, modelled new from your photos; the tents along the main stand's back show their peaks above the roof. Trees on the hill behind, as in your photos.

The whole ground between the run-in and the sprint course: the half along the run-in faces the stands (marquees, big tops, rows of balloons, its rail crowd stood back so the infield car runs clear), the half along the sprint faces the sprint (little stands, decks, marquees, a crowd on its rail). Trodden ground round each piece, lawn between.
The far side of the sprint.
A band of bushes along its whole length: dark hedges in runs with clumps between, three rows of bushes behind, a loose row of trees; boards on its far rail at the finish.

From your two Racing TV videos. Round races: head-on down the home straight from the west bend, the infield car alongside with the stand side behind, high across the west bend, the infield car down the back straight over the golf course, head-on behind the chase fences, head-on round the far bend, the infield car up the run-in, then the finish square on from the infield with the stands behind. The sprint: one car alongside on the festival side looking across at the bushes, then its finish from the near rail.

stands._about: Owner, 19 Nov 10:02: 'two main grandstands with a tent like pavillion to the rear' and his photos. The pieces are sandown_stands_kit (tools/blender/build_sandown_stands.py): the main (Esher) stand with the white peaked tents along its back, and the Eclipse stand on its right seen from the course (past the post), on OSM's footprints (the main stand x -96..93, the block x -155..-105).

perimeter.note: Sandown (19 Nov): the infield is the golf course (north of the sprint course) and the ground between the sprint course and the run-in (the go-karts in real life): there, as every course, the festival opposite the stands. No generic infield belt (it stood in the sprint course's cameras); parkland trees scattered over the golf course instead. Behind the stands the wooded hill (his photos: tall trees behind both stands). 13:28: a full festival between the run-in and the sprint course (two halves, sandown_zones.py), the bushes along the sprint's far side (edges_sandown.py).
